title: Electricity bring modern education to tribal community in Bukidnon

blocks.text: SAN FERNANDO, BUKIDNON, Philippines — Over 300 indigenous learners in a remote village here now have access to modern education after officials energized the Salumayag Tigwahanon Integrated School under the national government’s Last Mile Schools Electrification Program on Friday, Oct. 23, 2026. National Electrification Administration (NEA) Administrator Antonio Mariano Almeda led the ceremonial switch-on in Sitio Salumayag, Barangay Halapitan, alongside executives from the First Bukidnon Electric Cooperative, Inc. (FIBECO), educators, students, and local Tigwahanon tribal elders. The energization directly benefits 315 elementary and high school Lumad students, bridging a long-standing digital and educational divide in one of the province’s most geographically […]...
